description:
FIRST OF ALL,

I think you’d find that building the kind of life you feel excited about could actually be pretty fun.

The obstacle isn’t your capacity, it’s the pain you experience in relation to the project that very validly makes you want to numb. 

By procrastinating. Avoidance is less painful.

But here is what your answer says about you—

0-1 Days—You are terrified of your own thoughts and if you ever stop moving they might catch up with you so you can’t ever do anything leisurely or the existential dread will crush you. You’re wrong, but you want take my word for it. Please rest. Please.

Rest of the answers in the comments ✨
transcript: If you had a year of completely free time, all expenses paid, and for the fucking nitpickers, yeah you get like a baseline of savings and some disposable income but nothing extravagant, how long would it take you before you exhausted your ordinary free time activities and hobbies and started working on that project or change that you care about you've been putting off? I'll tell you what your answer says about you in the caption or the comments or something. I'm going this way if you want to come.
